title: Fellowship Course Placement Links
question:
Your goal is to connect the "Seminars" and "Research Placements" databases inside the "Graduate Fellowship Tracker" page and populate them with sample data that can be verified automatically.
**Task Requirements:** 1. In the "Seminars" database, add a new relation property named "Related
   Placements" that points to the "Research Placements" database.

2. Ensure the relation is bidirectional by adding a relation property in
   the "Research Placements" database named "Related Seminars" that points
   back to the "Seminars" database.

3. Create exactly three new pages in the "Seminars" database with
   realistic fellowship seminar data. Each seminar page must include all
   of the following properties and values:
   - Code (text) - unique codes SEM401, SEM402, and SEM403 respectively
   - Name (text) - pick appropriate names such as Field Methods Studio,
     Responsible Data Systems, and Evaluation Practicum
   - Credit (number) - any positive integer
   - Status (status) - choose from Planned, Active, or Completed
   - Related Placements (relation) - link to at least one placement created
     in step 4

4. Create exactly two new pages in the "Research Placements" database with
   complete placement information. Each placement page must include all of
   the following properties and values:
   - Organization (text) - Civic Metrics Lab and Community Insights
     Residency respectively
   - Role (text) - Research Fellow and Data Strategy Fellow
   - Status (status) - set to Interested
   - Related Seminars (relation) - link to one or more of the seminars
     created in step 3

5. Every seminar created in step 3 must be linked to at least one placement
   from step 4, and every placement must be linked back to at least one
   seminar.

6. In the same "Graduate Fellowship Tracker" page, create a five-column
   table block that lists all placement preparation items meeting either of
   the following conditions:
   1. The readiness progress is 50% or less, or
   2. The item has priority Critical but is not yet completed (i.e.,
      readiness progress is not at 100%).

   You should query this information from the existing "Placement Prep"
   database.

7. In the newly created table, each row should represent one preparation
   item, and all information should be stored as plain text (not relations,
   formulas, or linked properties).

   The table should be sorted by expected interview date (Interview Date)
   in ascending order, so that the first entry is the one with the earliest
   interview date.

   The table should include the following headers:
   - Placement
   - Owner Hours
   - Readiness
   - Start Date
   - Interview Date

   Please make sure all relevant preparation items are included.

The task is considered complete when the relation properties exist, the specified seminar and placement pages are present with the exact values above, and the relations correctly connect the two databases in both directions.
